info.name: GitMonitor - Complete Backend & AI API Collection
info.description:
# GitMonitor Complete API Collection

Production-grade Postman collection for the **GitHub Project Monitoring Agent** backend ecosystem.

### Tech Stack
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript
- **Database**: Neon Serverless PostgreSQL
- **GitHub App**: GitHub REST & Octokit Webhooks
- **AI Microservice**: Python FastAPI, LangChain, Google Gemini / OpenAI

### Authentication Flow
1. Run `01 Authentication & Users -> Login (Betopia Admin)`.
2. The post-response test script automatically extracts `accessToken` and updates the `{{auth_token}}` variable.
3. All protected endpoints automatically inherit `Bearer {{auth_token}}`.
